title: Maine’s data center revolt will decide who controls the Senate
hook_text: Maine's Senate race is about AI
script:
A voter shouted at Republican Senator Susan Collins during her final debate.
The man yelled that AI data centers are destroying the climate and poisoning water.
Collins dismissed the outburst by tying the man directly to her Democratic challenger.
Power-hungry data centers have become the central debate in Maine's tight midterms.
Voters worry these massive facilities will spike electricity bills across the state.
Could energy demands from tech infrastructure decide control of the US Senate?
